decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's plural-component pumping and injection know-how, so the firm can interpret early results and keep improving it, and it was still presented on its own page in 2019.
Like Product A, this injection unit lies close to the firm's core fluid-handling competence and in-house engineering, which favours retention.
Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's spray application expertise, giving it strong related knowledge to learn from results and refine the product.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory closely tied to the firm's main pump business and existing knowledge base.
This air-assisted airless gun line with several models extends the firm's established spray technology, so it can assimilate feedback and adapt the line.

A data logger relies on electronics and software knowledge far from the firm's mechanical core, and its downgrade from its own page in 2018 to a mere mention in 2019 suggests weak traction the firm struggles to interpret and build on.
